map.¥(人民币/CNY)、$(美元/USD)、€(欧元/EUR)、£(英镑/GBP): ¥(CNY), $(USD), €(EUR) and £(GBP) are the common signs; ISO 4217 identifies each currency with a unique three-letter code, which avoids sign ambiguity (since $ is shared by many countries).
